page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 8 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 62.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. For graphics and accelerated computing workloads, it includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for its hardware class. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1897.68 and a multi-core score of 28616.81, while the Geekbench multi-core score reaches 12885.0. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block bandwidth of 1617.72 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 28.19 GB/sec. The fractional GPU enables moderate machine learning capabilities, achieving 32.87 tokens per second for prompt processing and 10.13 tokens per second for text generation on a medium 7B LLM model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation allows users to access hardware acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. This resource density makes it a viable option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not fully saturate a whole graphics card. However, the lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This instance is suited for entry-level AI inference, ray tracing, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
